option_relations.rationale: Vitamin K-dependent coagulation factor deficiency syndrome does not match the clinical presentation of progressive skin laxity and elastic fiber calcification.
Classic pseudoxanthoma elasticum is a subtype of pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like disorders, which includes the leaf disease B2.2.
Classical Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum (PXE) is a subtype of pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like disorders, which includes the leaf disease B2.2.
Pseudoxanthoma elasticum-like disorder with coagulation deficiency matches the clinical presentation and genetic findings of the leaf disease B2.2.
